pr_title: Feature: Added Git columns to the details layout
pr_body:
## Feature: Added Git columns to the details layout

Added some git columns for git repos.

### Tasks

- [x] Added git columns (git Status, last commit date, message, author, and SHA).
- [x] Added an ability to show git info for each item.
- [x] Added an ability to customize git columns width.
- [x] Added an ability to hide and/or show git columns
- [x] Added an ability to store git columns visibility preferences.
- [x] Added an ability to store git columns width preferences.
- [x] Added an ability to make all git columns to fit.
- [x] Added an ability to set git columns hide/show preferences as default.
- [ ] Added an ability to sort
- [x] Brush up...

### PR Checklist

- [x] Were these changes approved in an issue or discussion with the project maintainers? In order to prevent extra work, feature requests and changes to the codebase must be approved before the pull request will be reviewed. This prevents extra work for the contributors and maintainers.
   Closes #12431
- [x] Did you build the app and test your changes?
- [ ] Did you check for accessibility? You can use Accessibility Insights for this.
- [ ] Did you remove any strings from the en-us resource file?
   - [ ] Did you search the solution to see if the string is still being used? 
- [ ] Did you implement any design changes to an existing feature?
   - [ ] Was this change approved?
- [ ] Are there any other steps that were used to validate these changes?
   1. Open app.
   2. Go to repository dir.
   3. See what happen next.

- right click every header and test the size to fit menu option

comments: @0x5bfa thank you for implementing this feature.

review_comments: I don't think we should reduce information which you can get from variable names.
These are implied
To be consistent with XAML, we should leave as it is.
I don't think this one should be nullable, I mean you always assign a value to it
let me fix after 2.5
And here as well...
As above.
What is `parentPath` needed for? You never change neither it nor `currentPath`
i didnt created this method. let me check after 2.5
@gave92 did you create this?
Let me change it later
Maybe these should be set to false by default (at least until we have behavior to auto hide the non git columns).
We already have it. If the dir is not git repo, git columns will be hidden. And if it is git repo, they will be shown.
The non git columns are still visible, until we have behavior to auto hide the other columns, I think we should limit which columns are being added to save space.
You mean if dir is git repo, you wanna git columns to be unvisible?
Let's forget this for now.
As above.
Instead of having an extra value in the model, maybe we can use a converter to display `Status` as a string.
It is not extra info. You have also DateTimeOffset properties in ListedItem, which are not used in UI.
Isn't this the same exact value as "Status"?
Status is ChangeKind enum such as 'Ignored', 'Modified', 'Added'.
I dont understand why you suggest that I should remove 'Last'.
The "Last" is implied for all of the git columns so it's just repetitive in my opinion.
Should I create a new class named GitCommitItem for this? If we are going to add more git columns in the future, LastCommit words would be needed.
It's your call but I think we should address that if/when we add more columns.
For now, we should not remove any words from current variable names.
What does adding `IsHidden` do?
Double check.

- UserCollapsed means user has hidden the column
- IsHidden means the column is hidden b/c it should not be shown in the current folder (it's not e.g a git folder)
Why remove 'Date'...
To be consistent with the column name in the UI.
What do you mean? You removed 'Date' in columns UI? Oh...
Please do not remove "Last" and "Date" from anywhere. If you remove them, I will suggest again in upcoming cleanup PR.
The UI is "Last commit", I got the idea from File Explorer but it's also shorter. I'm sorry for pushing the commit without telling you first.
